logline: At a house party a man steps to the bar mic, asks the DJ to turn him up, tells eleven years of love in pictures on the wall, and ends with his chin raised and the volume up.
reading:
The poem is a spoken-word set about the right to be heard after a long love ends. It opens with the voice held down: eyes wide shut, chin nested at the arch of the weight of his own words. The love story comes as ghosts walking off through sun-soaked evergreen fields (the page says vineyards, unnourished), treasures that escape one by one, and stars that dim.

It turns on L05: 'I've walked a thousand light years across the greatest divide to be heard. So DJ please turn me up.' After that plea the losses read as testimony: wedding bands diverging across abstract skies, a shared home boxed and trucked down one-way streets with no U-turns, eleven years plucked off like daisy petals (we love, we not), and three roads to choose from: heavy rain, frontal fog, or dim night lights under a cloud with a silver lining. The litany 'one night / one tear / one call to a friend / one open mic at a time' brings him back to the first image reversed: chin now nested high, volume turned up.
motifs: chin nested low -> chin nested high (the poem's frame)
the volume fader and VU needle going into the red
microphone held out toward the booth
two ghosts walking away down sunlit rows
stars dimming one by one (defamed, unsalted stars)
two rings sliding apart; a home boxed into two trucks on one-way streets
eleven daisy petals: we love, we not
three roads: rain, fog, dim lights with a silver lining

light_and_texture: Two light worlds: the party in magenta and violet with teal haze, and the memory images on the wall in washed daylight gold and grey. Make the room from layered corrugated card: a dark-stained card bar with a cut gel strip for neon underglow, a painted brick card for the projection wall with a real rectangular hole where the archive plays, and a black ceiling card pricked with pinholes and lit from behind so the stars can go out one by one. Haze is torn tracing paper slid sideways; the strobe is exposure flicker, not drawn.

Archive of a house or furniture being boxed and two moving vans pulling apart (search: moving day, moving van, Allied/Mayflower industrial films); nothing in the found set
Wedding bands: no match. Draw two gold ring cards on a black field and slide them apart in code
One-way street, NO U-TURN and STOP sign cards (the poem's 'not built with u-turns or stop / maybe we shouldn't signs')
POET chin-down and chin-high head cards, and a sunglasses card that reads 'eyes shut' (lenses tilted down, brows knit)
The DJ, the guests and the EX ghost all exist only as blank layouts; nothing is painted

characters.role: The speaker at the bar mic: he begins pressed down by his story and ends lifted by it
characters.costume: Black track jacket with red piping from the shoulders down the chest, black track trousers, black Chelsea boots; black sunglasses as their own plug-in card. Paint a neon magenta rim down one side and a cyan wall-spill on the other

actions.name: chin nested
actions.beats: head level -> chin drops onto the mic on 'weight' -> holds low through 'spoken words' -> small dip on each beat
actions.cutout: Neck brad; swap to the chin-down head card (about 20 degrees, crown forward). The mic hand rises under the chin at the elbow brad. The body card sinks 1 cm on each beat

actions.name: mic held out (passage)
actions.beats: pull the mic in -> extend the arm to full length toward the booth -> hold through 'to be heard' -> bring it back on 'turn me up'
actions.cutout: Shoulder and elbow brads lock straight; the grip(microphone) hand card stays. The head is the profile card facing the booth

actions.name: eleven petals
actions.beats: daisy raised to the mic -> pinch, pull, drop, eleven times on the syllables -> bare stem falls -> palm stays open
actions.cutout: Daisy card with 11 petals on tabs that come off one by one; the pinch hand travels on a wrist brad; at the end swap to the open-palm hand card

actions.name: chin high
actions.beats: turn to the room -> head lifts past level on 'chin now nested high' -> free arm opens -> hold for the drop
actions.cutout: Chin-high head card; the free arm swings out on the shoulder brad to the open hand; a light/shadow split comes from a half-card mask

cards_needed: body: threequarter walk and back stand (before the wall)
characters.note: poet.07.action has only one 'stand · front' frame plus seven empty hand cells. It is missing the walk (07.3a profile), the back stand before the wall (07.6a) and any head-angle cards, so it cannot do chin-down to chin-high, the poem's main movement. The costume notes are right: red piping, Chelsea boots, sunglasses as a separate card

characters.role: The DJ the plea is aimed at. They answer by pushing the fader: the turn of the poem made physical
characters.costume: Bomber jacket with LED piping (paint the piping as a bright cyan line, cut through so light shows behind), cap, over-ear headphones round the neck. Give them a face and build clearly different from POET's; the style strip on the pack shows POET-like heads, which risks a double

actions.name: drop in and scratch
actions.beats: drop from the landing -> crouch behind the decks -> scratch back and forth -> hold the pose for the cheer
actions.cutout: The crouch is a replacement body; the R hand flat_push card rocks on the wrist brad over a rotating record card

actions.name: push the volume
actions.beats: eyes on POET -> nod -> thumb pushes the fader up its slot -> VU needle swings into the red
actions.cutout: Fader knob card in a cut slot in the controller card; the needle on a brad, driven in code

characters.note: party.07.action has the right six poses (crouch front, dance threequarter_back, two leans, dance back, dance front) and eight hand cells, but nothing is painted, and the DJ shares the sheet with the guests, so DJ and guest sizing are mixed

fx.how: VU needle card on a brass brad, rotated in code; the red zone is a painted arc; on 'turn me up' the needle pins, and the mic's gel halo card fades in
Black ceiling card with pinholes, lit from behind; tape over one hole per beat as he walks (or mask each in code), timed to 'diminish their glares'
Print the POET and EX back cards on tracing paper (or composite at 45% in code) and composite them inside the projection screen over the vine-row clip, scaling down as they recede
Eleven loose paper petal cards dropped on string-free paths in code with a small flutter rotation, landing in a pile on the bar card
The screen clip is blurred and added onto a cyan floor-spill card and onto the faces turned toward it
Gel-coloured light from two sides (magenta key, teal rim); haze as two torn tracing-paper strips drifting at different speeds
Exposure flicker on beat 1 of each bar only; never over the passage line
A half-card black mask over POET's left side for 07.7a; a thin silver paint line on the cloud card edge picks up the light

passage.keep: L05 is the right fulcrum and the gesture is right: one held action, the mic held out at arm's length toward the booth, kept there through 'to be heard'. The Tulsa clip ('so that all may be heard') answers the meaning, not just the word.
passage.better: The plate P07-001 carries a generated DJ figure, which fights the puppet. Use a figure-free booth (the empty-booth plate prompt above) with our cut-out DJ, and open the archive in the projection wall's screen, a large vertical pane, rather than a small strip of wall above the DJ's head. End the hold on the DJ's thumb pushing the fader as 'turn me' lands, so the archive and the fader answer together. Use the profile head card toward the booth, not a rotated front head.
alt_lines: 07_L01 'eyes wide shut and my chin nested...': head lowers (chin-down card) onto the mic; the archive opens in the bar's back mirror/bottle shelf glass
07_L08-09 'eleven years each plucked off as daisy petals / we love we not': pinch and drop petals; the daisy close-up (arch_e31a6321) fills the projection screen
07_L09-10 'to pick a road of heavy rain or a frontal fog...': point held at the third pane; the three roads open in the split wall
07_L12 'Chin now nested high and volume turned up': head lifts (chin-high card), free hand opens; the archive opens in the projection wall

ideas: Vine-row ghosts: the Soil Explorers rows (arch_83ab12f7-191f) play in the projection wall; translucent POET and EX back cards walk into it and get smaller, while the real POET at the bar keeps his eyes shut

Stars go out one by one: the Snow Queen stars (arch_bfbcbfa6-1e8b) map onto the pinhole ceiling, and each hole is taped over on 'one by one treasures escaping'
